summary: 39-year-old Aspen man traveled out of bounds off Ruthie's Run on Aspen Mountain and was located in Keno Gulch in the Castle Creek valley; cold, tired and intoxicated but otherwise uninjured; Aspen Mountain Ski Patrol and Mountain Rescue Aspen entered the field ~8:05 pm, made physical contact ~10:06 pm, and all rescuers were out by 11:40 pm; the Air Force Rescue Coordination Center assisted in locating him via his cell phone
location: Ruthie's Run / Keno Gulch, Aspen Mountain (Castle Creek valley)
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff; Mountain Rescue Aspen; Aspen Mountain Ski Patrol
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — the SnowBrains article gives only 'Saturday evening'; search-index freshness pins publication ~2021-03-22 (Monday), and 2021-03-20 was a Saturday.
